footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Postal Realty Trust: after $3.9M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $2.7M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 25.5% to $95.8M in 2025. Operating income rose 62.1% to $34.3M, a 35.8% margin.
Net income rose 2.4× to $11.5M, or $0.47 per share. Operating cash flow was $44.5M and free cash flow $37.6M, versus $30.7M; Postal Realty Trust returned $30.8M through dividends.
